name: Big Number Underline
description: Transparent 9:16 overlay where a huge bold white number pops in centered in the upper third with a soft pop SFX, a thick purple underline draws left to right beneath it, a short white label fades up below, and everything exits with a quick fade-down.
bestFor: social clips that need a single headline number over the speaker
replace: data-duration on #root if clip length differs
GSAP exit timing at 3.5s if hold duration needs adjusting
features: overlay only — transparent background, no footage element
number, underline and label kept inside the social safe zone in the upper third
number pops in with back.out scale
thick purple (#7c3aed) underline draws left to right via scaleX
white Satoshi label fades up under the underline
soft pop SFX synced to the number
quick fade-down exit for the whole block
Cabinet Grotesk ExtraBold number loaded from local assets/fonts
